title: Holding through consolidation
description: Lower lows at 27,384, 27,340 and then 27,111 (30 Aug 14:00), which holds for 25 hours before the latest close of 26,918 falls through it. That close is itself the latest lower low, and a lower close would move it down. Labels are relative: the bounce to 27,467 at 08:00 is a higher high because it beats the previous high of 27,465 by 2.
